messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PDR-8891 fired for service `inference-gateway-eu-central` — error-rate alert (1m spike 6.3% 5xx > 2%). Auto-page issued to rotation `infra-oncall` and `runtime-oncall`. PD: https://pd.internal/PDR-8891
pagerbot: PagerDuty event created and routed. Escalation policy: primary -> immediate secondary after 1m.
Nora: acked — I'm on it. starting quick triage.
Sam: looking at graphs — spike starts 2026-03-15T23:58Z. 502s and 504s from front-proxy layer; origin traces show many CONNECT failures to upstream pools.
Priya: tailing proxy logs, seeing a repeated error: `accept: too many file descriptors` and `keepalive pool exhaustion`. sample:```
2026-03-15T23:58:34Z proxy-2 req=req_9fa accept: too many file descriptors
2026-03-15T23:58:35Z proxy-5 req=req_a01 keepalive: pool depleted
``` 
Nora: is this a canary? any deploys in the last hour?
Sam: yes, proxy image `frontier-proxy:2.7.0` rolled at 23:20 UTC with a connection-pool optimization flag. Could be regressing FD usage.
Priya: bridge created: https://meet.internal/bridges/5512342222 (auto-join infra+runtime+oncall).
Nora: immediate mitigations: (1) divert traffic away from canary proxy nodes, (2) scale backend workers, (3) consider rollback. I'll run route change and scale now.
Nora: executing:
```
kubectl label node proxy-canary-1 keep=false --overwrite
kubectl scale deploy inference-workers -n prod --replicas=40
```
pagerbot: PD note: acknowledgement received from Nora at 23:59:12Z, but PD escalated to secondary at 23:59:55Z due to a transient PD API latency window.
Nora: I saw the escalation notification — looks like PD didn't process ack quickly. Can OpsLead suppress duplicate escalations?
OpsLead: suppressing automatic escalations for 15m to avoid noise while we mitigate. Marking manual suppression in PD.
Sam: after routing change, proxy logs on canary nodes drop errors; non-canary nodes still healthy. 5xx rate trending down: 1m avg 2.4%, 5m avg 3.9% and falling.
Priya: starting a rollback for frontier-proxy to 2.6.5 on canary slice. Command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/frontier-proxy frontier=ghcr.io/redwood/frontier-proxy:2.6.5 -n prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/frontier-proxy -n prod --watch
```
bridge-bot: Rollout initiated for `frontier-proxy` -> ghcr.io/redwood/frontier-proxy:2.6.5. Watching rollout.
Priya: rollback completed on canary nodes; logs indicate FD errors stop at 00:02:10Z.
Sam: observing connection backlog drop and keepalive reuse normalizing. 5xx 1m avg now 1.1%, 5m avg 2.0%.
Nora: lifting traffic diversion back to normal gradually and keeping workers scaled for a bit.
pagerbot: PD incident PDR-8891: acknowledged, mitigation in progress, suppression active.
Priya: collecting request ids with failures for post-incident analysis: r7Kz, rL0q, rT2m — attaching to incident.
Sam: noted that the new pooling change in 2.7.0 altered per-socket lifetime; likely a regression in ephemeral-socket cleanup. Eng-runtime to own RCA.
Nora: planned handoff: I'll keep watch until 00:30 UTC. If 1m 5xx > 2% we reopen bridge. Jun: (on watch) I'll take the follow-up.
OpsLead: creating PD incident note summarizing actions: diversion -> scale -> rollback, PD ack bounce during PD maintenance window, suppression applied. Assigning owners: @eng-runtime, @infra.
Priya: quick follow-ups: ensure canary gating includes FD leak regression test; add alert to watch FD usage on proxy nodes.
Nora: adding runbook entry and brief timeline to PD and the incident board.
incident-bot: Incident PDR-8891 marked mitigated by manual rollback and routing. Final notes archived.
Nora: closing thread here; will publish a short postmortem in 2 days. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks team.
Priya: will open an RCA ticket and link PD.
Jun: acknowledged watch handoff. will report if anything changes.
